Karnataka mandates FIRs for revenge porn and sextortion cases

Karnataka has announced mandatory First Information Reports (FIRs) for cases involving revenge porn and sextortion. This directive aims to ensure a victim-centric approach in handling such complaints. The move is intended to provide immediate legal recourse and protection to victims.
